record.paper: Subdivisions in digraphs of large out-degree or large dichromatic number

dossier_meta.paper: Subdivisions in digraphs of large out-degree or large dichromatic number
dossier_meta.context_text: The paper proves in Section 3 that every digraph is $\vec{\chi}$-maderian. Since every digraph of order $n$ is a subdigraph of $\vec{K}_n$, bounding $\mathrm{mader}_{\vec{\chi}}(\vec{K}_n)$ controls all cases. The paper establishes $\mathrm{mader}_{\vec{\chi}}(\vec{K}_n) \leq 4^{n^2-2n+1}(n-1)+1$ (Corollary 36), but the exact value is unknown.
